name: Amnesiac
summary: A stretch of your past was swallowed by nothingness; the skills, tool and languages of your origin return to you one at a time.

features.name: Scattered Memories
features.summary: You start with no skills, tool or origin languages; you recall two skills, one tool and two languages later, one at a time and at most one per level.
features.text: You don't choose skill proficiencies, a tool proficiency or the two languages of your origin when you make the hero: those are the parts of your past you have lost. At any time during play you can recall one of them: a skill, the tool, or a language (two skills and two languages are waiting, one tool). The memory may return as a flash, even in the middle of a roll that depends on it, or surface slowly while you work at a problem. Once you recall one, you can't recall another until you gain a level. The GM (a story event, such as finding evidence of your past or meeting something like a forgotten event) can allow an earlier recall; the game offers a Remember option before a check the hero isn't proficient in.
